title: Google Workspace Sending Limits: 2,000 a Day, 500 on Trial
meta_description: Read on 20 October 2026: each paid Google Workspace user may send 2,000 emails a day. Trial accounts get 500, and Google ties the raise to $100 paid.
secondary_keywords: google workspace email sending limit per day

image.takeaway: A new Google Workspace account starts at 500 emails a day, and Google ties the raise to $100 paid.
image.alt: Google Workspace sending limits: each paid user can send 2,000 emails a day, while a trial account gets 500, and Google ties the raise for a converted trial to $100 of payments
